subject: current-affairs
title: Important Global Indices 2026
description: Major global indices, their publishing organizations, and India's rank

content.overview: Global indices measure countries' performance across various parameters. Important for UPSC/PSC exams.
keyPoints: Human Development Index (HDI): UNDP, India rank 134 (2023)
Global Peace Index (GPI): Institute for Economics and Peace, India rank 116
World Happiness Report: UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network, India rank 126
Global Gender Gap Index: World Economic Forum, India rank 127
World Press Freedom Index: Reporters Without Borders, India rank 161
Environmental Performance Index (EPI): Yale/Columbia, India rank 180
Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Index: UN, India rank 111
Global Terrorism Index: Institute for Economics and Peace, India rank 13
Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI): Transparency International, India rank 93
Network Readiness Index (NRI): Portulans Institute, India rank 49
Energy Transition Index (ETI): World Economic Forum, India rank 63
Henley Passport Index: Henley & Partners, India rank 85
Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI): Germanwatch, India rank 7
Global Hunger Index (GHI): Concern Worldwide/Welthungerhilfe, India rank 105
Innovation Index: WIPO Global Innovation Index, India rank 39
Democracy Index: Economist Intelligence Unit, India rank 41
Global Competitiveness Index: World Economic Forum, India rank 40
Ease of Doing Business: World Bank, India rank 63 (discontinued)
Global Innovation Index: WIPO, India rank 39
World Risk Index: UNU-EHS, India rank 29

mnemonics.trick: UNDP-HDI, WEF-GGGI, T-CPI, WIPO-GII, EIU-Democracy, G-Germanwatch, H-Henley
mnemonics.explanation: UNDP (HDI), WEF (Gender Gap), Transparency (CPI), WIPO (Innovation), EIU (Democracy), Germanwatch (Climate), Henley (Passport)

quiz.question: Which organization publishes the Human Development Index?
quiz.explanation: UNDP publishes the Human Development Index (HDI)

quiz.question: Corruption Perceptions Index is published by:
quiz.explanation: Transparency International publishes the Corruption Perceptions Index

quiz.question: Global Innovation Index is published by:
quiz.explanation: WIPO (World Intellectual Property Organization) publishes the Global Innovation Index
